trans-unit.id:
Displays will turn blank for a while and you will not be able to interact with your Mac. The process should take about 2-4 seconds.
The process does not work for the built-in display (reboot needed). The operation might cause some Macs to enter sleep mode.
trans-unit.source:
Displays will turn blank for a while and you will not be able to interact with your Mac. The process should take about 2-4 seconds.
The process does not work for the built-in display (reboot needed). The operation might cause some Macs to enter sleep mode.
trans-unit.target:
Skärmarna blir svarta under en stund och du kan inte interagera med din Mac. Processen bör ta cirka 2 till 4 sekunder.
Processen fungerar inte för den inbyggda bildskärmen (omstart krävs). Åtgärden kan leda till att vissa Mac-datorer går in i viloläge.
trans-unit.note: 53477 - Display configuration activation warning describing a temporary blank screen and built-in display limitation.

trans-unit.id: Get the current value of any adjustment for the display. The value will be converted to a scale of 0-1.
trans-unit.source: Get the current value of any adjustment for the display. The value will be converted to a scale of 0-1.
trans-unit.target: Hämta det aktuella värdet för en justering av skärmen. Värdet konverteras till en skala från 0 till 1.
